welcomeEnabled.title: Welcome new viewers
welcomeEnabled.description: Show the welcome notice when a viewer enters.

tipAcknowledgmentEnabled.title: Tip acknowledgment notices
tipAcknowledgmentEnabled.description: Toggle thank-you notices; tip and VIP tracking continue.

loyaltyEnabled.title: Enable loyalty points
loyaltyEnabled.description: Master switch for daily, viewing, and chat point awards.

dailyVisitPoints.title: Daily visit points
dailyVisitPoints.description: Points awarded once per viewer each UTC day. 0 disables.

watchPointsPerFiveMinutes.title: Viewing points per 5 minutes
watchPointsPerFiveMinutes.description: Points per completed 5-minute viewing interval. 0 disables.

meaningfulChatPoints.title: Meaningful chat points
meaningfulChatPoints.description: Points per eligible chat message. 0 disables this award.

settingsHelp.title: Configuration guide
settingsHelp.description: Native settings; saved balances and room activity are preserved.
settingsHelp.default: Afterdark Brotherhood · No map. No supervision. Questionable decisions.

tipMenuDisplayEnabled.title: Show informational tip menu
tipMenuDisplayEnabled.description: Controls !tipmenu and !menu. Saved menu items are preserved.

tipMenuTitle.title: Tip menu heading
tipMenuTitle.description: Custom heading shown above the existing menu items.

tipMenuFooter.title: Tip menu footer
tipMenuFooter.description: Short note shown below menu items. Leave blank for no footer.
tipMenuFooter.default: Tips are voluntary. Menu items are requests, not guaranteed outcomes. No game access or advantage is tied to tipping.

announcementIntervalMinutes.title: Announcement interval (minutes)
announcementIntervalMinutes.description: Used when rotating announcements are enabled. Minimum 5 minutes.

giveawayEnabled.title: Enable free giveaways
giveawayEnabled.description: Allow free giveaway viewing and entry. Saved entries remain.

viewerQueueEnabled.title: Enable viewer queue
viewerQueueEnabled.description: Allow queue actions. Saved queue entries and bookings remain.

viewerQueueMaxWaitlist.title: Maximum waitlist size
viewerQueueMaxWaitlist.description: Maximum queue size. Lowering it does not delete entries.

goalDefaultDurationMinutes.title: Default goal timer (minutes)
goalDefaultDurationMinutes.description: Default timer for new goals. 0 means no timer.

goalCarryoverDefault.title: Default token overflow carryover
goalCarryoverDefault.description: Default carryover choice for newly created goals.

goalAutoRepeatDefault.title: Default automatic goal repeat
goalAutoRepeatDefault.description: Default repeat choice for newly created goals.

broadcastPanelStyle.title: Room panel layout
broadcastPanelStyle.description: Choose the goal-focused or game-and-record panel layout.

gameCodebreakerEnabled.title: Codebreaker
gameCodebreakerEnabled.description: Allow viewer participation. Owner controls remain available.

gameWordScrambleEnabled.title: Word Scramble
gameWordScrambleEnabled.description: Allow viewer participation. Owner controls remain available.

gameWouldYouRatherEnabled.title: Dirty Would You Rather
gameWouldYouRatherEnabled.description: Allow viewer participation. Owner controls remain available.

gamePositionImpossibleEnabled.title: Position Impossible
gamePositionImpossibleEnabled.description: Allow viewer participation. Owner controls remain available.

gameDirtyCharadesEnabled.title: Dirty Charades
gameDirtyCharadesEnabled.description: Allow viewer participation. Owner controls remain available.

rewardRedemptionEnabled.title: Allow viewer reward browsing and redemption
rewardRedemptionEnabled.description: Allow catalogue browsing and new reward requests.

vipCuriousThresholdUsd.title: The Curious ($)
vipCuriousThresholdUsd.description: Lifetime direct room-tip amount required for this tier.
